note: Re-judged 2026-11-10 (independent closure auditor, spec-ipsec-esp-offer-requires-esn) after affa3d8684 and da3ff616f6. Section 3.3 (rfc/full/rfc7296.txt): "If an initiator wants to propose both combined- mode ciphers and normal ciphers, it must include two proposals". Both receive-side units changed only by adding espESNTransform() (Type 5, ID 0), judge-approved in affa3d8684. Without it espProposalMatches now refuses every offer at the mandatory-type mask, which would leave TestAeadMixInOneProposalIsRefused passing for the wrong reason and TestAeadAloneInItsOwnProposalIsAccepted red. With it the mixed offer passes the mask, encryption and ESN checks and differs from the accepted explicitNone offer only by the INTEG id, so the refusal is again isolated to the AEAD-with-integrity rule (question 3), and the two positives (absent INTEG, INTEG NONE) still rule out a refuse-every-AEAD comparison. The send-side TestESPProposalsNeverMixAEADClass is unchanged. Negative revert record re-recorded over the changed unit. Retain enforced. Prior judgement: Re-judged 2026-09-30 after R30 D-8 (lookups return errors). The sentence (Section 3.3, rfc/full/rfc7296.txt:4308) obliges an initiator offering both classes to use two proposals. Send side: TestESPProposalsNeverMixAEADClass builds a group holding an AEAD and a non-AEAD proposal through the offer builder (now wireESPOffer via the test-only one-value wrapper) and asserts two proposals, AEAD with one ENCR and no INTEG, non-AEAD with one ENCR and one INTEG; a merge or an INTEG beside the AEAD cipher goes red. ipsec.ESPProposal holds one cipher, so the send-side negative is inexpressible (single-polarity positive on that side). Receive side: TestAeadMixInOneProposalIsRefused (negative) feeds espProposalMatches one proposal with the AEAD cipher plus a real INTEG and asserts refusal; TestAeadAloneInItsOwnProposalIsAccepted (positive, absent INTEG and explicit NONE) rules out a comparison that refuses every AEAD proposal. The edit to the negative is mechanical: lookupIntegrity now returns (T, error) and the test fails on the error; assertions and fixture unchanged. Records: negative revert on responder.go::espProposalMatches, observed red. The two positives carry no record (tags predate the record ratchet).
